title: Unit Event — Whither This Path of Thorns

meta.Outline: Mafuyu's big step forward in her own life inspires another member of N25. Before the School Festival, Mizuki resolves to open up to Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I was able to tell my dad everything.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can only imagine how scary that must've been for her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she didn't run from her dad. She worked up the courage to tell him the truth.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I kept running and running until now...
That's how I ended up where I am.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I've been clinging to what Ena said...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This time, I'm going to face it head-on.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If I'm really going to do this, I should tell Ena first...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Because she's been waiting all this time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I should ask to see when we can meet up...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can barely type... My hands are shaking like crazy...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Calm down...
Just type your message out one letter at a time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (All that's left is to hit send...)
They're kind of a pain to deal with.
Are we getting the wrong idea?
Oh, that sounds like a lot to handle...
Some people believe in the strangest things when they're young.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, they're all really nice... And they understand the meaning of real pain...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, since we've agreed on how I should proceed with the demo, let's call things here, shall we...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay.
Oh, my shoulders feel kinda sore today, so I should probably stretch them before I go to bed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's a good idea, since it sounds like you haven't been exercising...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, I have been exercising...!
Didn't I tell you that I've been going on walks with Kanade?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Urgh... Yeah, maybe not that often...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Just when I was beginning to think that you've been feeling better lately, you start snapping back at me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha!
But I like this banter since it's a nice whiff of what we're used to♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is it just me, or does something smell like one of those food stalls they have at festivals...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... What's this smell? Some kind of sauce?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Did one of you bring some food over today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know how our school's festival is coming up? My class is doing a grilled squid stall, and we've been practicing how to make it in the home ec room recently.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The school festival...
It's already that time of year?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're going to be participating, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... Yeah, I've been thinking about it.
The events I've been helping out with recently have all been fun, and I heard that Mizuki's class is doing something interesting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh... Y-Yeah!
We're turning our classroom into an escape room!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You have to solve a bunch of riddles hidden throughout in order to get out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
And last year's festival actually seemed pretty fun too, so I figure I could participate this year.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Though, I'm starting to wonder if it's such a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I realized today that grilling squid isn't as easy as it sounds. Plus, the smell ruins your clothes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm also working on a bunch of assignments for art class right now, so I don't really have much free time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I guess I'm holding off on deciding whether to go until like the day before.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, let me know if you're gonna be there! I wanna try the grilled squid you make...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If she does, she might end up hearing about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's even been a part of me that says it'd be just as well... And I've been stuck with it for this long.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really don't want things to turn out that way...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(If she really is coming...
Then I have to tell her before that.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, I have to tell her eventually...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She needs to hear it from me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna see what I can do about dealing with my own problems.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It seems that time has finally come...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a question about Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Something didn't seem quite right.
You need to tell me if you have any information.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm surprised to hear you asking about Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mizuki's words have the power to help Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mafuyu needs to hear them in order to move forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't actually have any details...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, as I told you when you first arrived, we're dealing with some very complicated feelings here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And it seems that Mizuki is currently setting the stage to face those feelings head-on...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I sensed quite a bit of doubt just now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What exactly is Mizuki afraid of or running from?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not in a position to say...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you going over to see Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mizuki is trying to cross a thin sheet of ice right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What you're planning on saying is going to be too strong. So strong that you might make that ice crack...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, you want me to do nothing...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If doing nothing will solve everything, then that's fine by me. But do you honestly believe that's going to bring about real change?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't think that your solution is always the best one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I made the decision to finally tell her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What's up?
You hardly ever come to see me like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You have no right asking such a question!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You really feel the need to intervene like this...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Fine.
But let me at least say this.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Mizuki.
You're stuck at a crossroads, yes?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I have no way of knowing what's eating away at you...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You find yourself at a crossroads because you're trying to make a choice... Because you want to make a choice, not because of anyone else.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I don't care if you decide to run or move forward...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But just know this... In the midst of this pain, you need to choose the path that allows you to save yourself.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I've witnessed the pain you bear.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I honestly believe that you shouldn't try to do anything...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Because what you're carrying...is so incredibly fragile.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I'll see this through with you.
No matter how things turn out.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Regardless of how the future unfolds, I'll be there with you until the end.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I... I just need a little bit more time...
The day before the school festival

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hey, did you manage to drape that cloth over it?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I didn't end up sending that message...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena seemed pretty busy, so maybe she won't...)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Then, we'll start decorating the entrance.
Akiyama, can the puzzle team handle setting everything up inside?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We already have the prompts written down and all the props we need, so we should be able to get everything set up pretty quickly!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Great!
Then, you take it from here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for preparing these props for us, Akiyama. I feel a little bad for not helping out more.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's totally fine! You did a great job coming up with a bunch of puzzle ideas for us, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it was actually nice to be kept so busy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something just now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, nothing...!
Anyway, we're short on time, so let's get everything set up on the double!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, let's.
I'm looking forward to seeing how everyone solves the riddles in our escape room.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... It looks like everything's where it needs to be, so I think we're done!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm inclined to agree after double-checking.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's start heading out!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, I plan on stopping by the library before heading home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. You've still gotta do library committee stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
In that case, bye bye!
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Either way, I need to tell her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If Ena does decide to show up, then before she...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, what's up...?!
Your class is doing that play, right? Are you guys all set up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had the cast go home in preparation for tomorrow, and was just handling cleanup.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see.
I might come check it out if I have time♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad you got to do a play this year, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me too.
And I have my class to thank...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How have things been on your end, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Us?
Our class is all set to go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We came up with a really elaborate escape room. Even you might have trouble solving all the riddles, Rui. You should totally stop by and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...
I guess that's not what you were asking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have known each other for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Why don't we talk in the courtyard...?
I should be done cleaning up soon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's still very warm, despite being fall.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It felt like old times, is all.
Remember how we used to chat while watching the sun set after school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah... I mean, we didn't have much else to do back then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All either of us was capable of back then was aimlessly watching as time flew by.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, if you don't feel comfortable telling me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm thinking about telling them everything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About myself. To the others in my group.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My mind is telling me to move forward, but I keep freezing up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are you afraid of the most...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A part of me is scared that they're going to reject me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But what I'm most afraid of is...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My relationship with the others could morph drastically...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Including how we all spend time together...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't want that to change...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know the others aren't like that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure they aren't going to reject me for who I am...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm feeling all this because I'm overthinking things way too much... I know they'll be willing to accept me just for who I am like you guys, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If I end up making them accept me for who I am.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If I force them to talk a certain way or treat me like a delicate flower...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If I start to feel like that's happening...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I... I don't think I can handle that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know I sound really selfish right now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Change is a scary thing, particularly if it involves someone you really care about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have no way of making the fear you're feeling disappear.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That you'll get to be yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can hope that you're going to experience true happiness.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's my sincere wish as your friend.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I don't care if you decide to run or move forward...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But just know this... In the midst of this pain, you need to choose the path that allows you to save yourself.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I'll see this through with you.
No matter how things turn out.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Regardless of how the future unfolds, I'll be there with you until the end.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That you'll get to be yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can hope that you're going to experience true happiness.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's my sincere wish as your friend.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This fear I'm feeling isn't going to just disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Enanan!
What's up? It still isn't time yet.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<About the festival tomorrow...
I'm thinking I'll go after all.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I was thinking about skipping, but I accidentally took home some of the spices and condiments we're going to use.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Just going to bring them back would be kinda lame, right? I also just finished my assignments, so I figure I'll actually stick around...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <K and Yuki sounded interested too, so why don't we all check it out together?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, let's check it out as a group tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Can we talk tomorrow during the night festival?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I finally managed to get that out...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, let's check it out as a group tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm such a wimp, even though I'm this close...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This might be the last time we get to hang out together like this...)
The day of the school festival

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, umm... Thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unlike the Miya Girls festival, you don't have to buy a ticket or anything to enter. So there's always a ton of people!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And my class has been super busy since this morning!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki, speaking of your class...
Do you not have to help out?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nope!
I worked reception this morning, so I'm free now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is Ena still helping out with her class...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, probably.
But I don't know for sure since I haven't heard from her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, would it be best for us to go visit her stall?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh... Yeah...
Alright, I'll let her know that we're headed her—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, it's not like I'm telling her right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Just act natural and talk like normal...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They're certainly sending a clear message...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Argh...!
That's why I hate this shirt so much!
My class got carried away and made it as a sick joke...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: B-But things aren't that bad, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, don't straddle the fence like that!
If you want to make fun of me, don't hold back! If you're gonna cheer me up, then come up with something better to say!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Now you're just being unreasonable!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I think that shirt suits you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, you're happy about receiving a compliment from her, but you're conflicted about it involving the shirt you're wearing...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't just lay it out bare like that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway... Now that we're all here, let's start checking everything out! Where should we start?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I feel like we should start by grabbing some squid from your class's stall...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I don't think any of us are hungry yet, so we should probably start by checking out whatever catches our eye!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We're gonna have so much fun today!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It must have to do with those messages I received yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It is bothering me...
But I promised to wait.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (So, for now, I'll focus on us having fun together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Going around school together like this is pretty scary...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... What's going on here...?

Hi, Mizuki!
Oh, you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What's wrong with that?
I am a student here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't say you couldn't come.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Anyway, how are things going?
Are you guys getting a lot of foot traffic?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What is it that your class is doing, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Basically, we're running a photo booth where you can try on all sorts of different costumes! A few of our classmates that are really into fashion design made them for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Really...?
Oh, look at that. There's a huge selection.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've got it all! Dresses, mandarin gowns, maid uniforms and even alien costumes! You're free to try on whatever you like and totally transform!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Then, wanna try on some of these?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You just want to have your picture taken, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No!
I thought we could make fun memories by taking some together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, Kusanagi!
We got four more coming in!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Wh-Whoa!!
An, don't pull so hard!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's been so long since I last saw a play at a school festival...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Me too.
But to be fair, these are usually hard to watch since they rely so much on dumb inside jokes and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not to worry!
Don't forget that Rui's the director!

rows.Speaker: Class 3-C Student
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us for this showing of “A Trip to the Moon”! The play will begin momentarily!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, it's about to start.
I wonder what the story's like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Alright, it's time to set off for the moon!!!!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I must succeed in reaching the moon and exploring all around it!!”

rows.Speaker: Class 3-C Students
rows.Line: “Ready, everyone?! We're sending Dr. Tenma to the moon!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Whoaaa!!!!
Through the atmosphere and to the moon!!!!”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And headfirst into the moon with a face on it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow... He's stuck jutting out of it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what happened to exploring the moon?! He basically just destroyed it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But this scene is true to the original film...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
We shouldn't expect anything less from Rui and Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really wasn't expecting to see the Earth get invaded by moon aliens at the end...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it sort of made me think about humanity's place in the universe.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? That part felt really thrown together to me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha!
Well, everyone's entitled to their own opinions.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, hey, Mizuki?
Can we head over to your class now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've actually been looking forward to trying your class's escape room.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No one should try to talk to me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But what about the person at reception...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “Escape From Kamiyama High School”... Is this it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I like how just the name of it already sets the mood.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's good, right?
Anyway, let's head in and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Toya!
Were you scheduled to work reception at this time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I had a slightly later shift, but someone asked me to switch...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hello.
It's been a little while.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it has.
I didn't realize that you'd all be here today...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope you enjoy our escape room since I helped come up with a few of the riddles.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As far as I can see, your classroom's all covered in black curtains... What's waiting for us inside...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You'll have to go in to find out.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since you're here, Akiyama, why don't you be the guide? Solving the riddles probably won't be very interesting since you already know all the answers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, I'll help you all navigate our escape room♪ So, let's go visit a world of riddles!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are escape rooms supposed to be this creepy?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
Welcome to “Escape From Kamiyama High School”!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think we're getting the introduction.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While you were all diligently setting up for the school festival, somebody has trapped you inside your classroom!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unless you find a way to escape within the next fifteen minutes, your teacher will surely come and scold you all for staying too late...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, your goal will be to escape by solving the riddles the perp left behind!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even though we're the ones who are trapped, we're going to get scolded...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Details, details!
Anyway, you all need to start solving the riddles!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Could the paper on that chair be one of them...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, you're right. What does it say?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “Look to the box which has never seen rust”...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A box that's never seen rust? What does that mean?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
Toya came up with that one!
Can you figure it out?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, this is the easiest one. If you can't solve this, then the others are gonna be impossible.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I know the answer...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think it's telling us to look in the broom locker.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?
How'd you land on that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Being resistant to rust is one of the key characteristics of stainless steel...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Most of these kinds of lockers are made of regular steel, but this one must be stainless steel...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, this one's a lot shinier than the ones you see in other classrooms...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Then, I'll try opening it.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Grr!
You figured it out so fast!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But there's plenty more where that came from! You gotta keep solving them before time runs out!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “If △〇△ is something red and ◆×◆ represents a nice gentleman, then what comes next?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. This one's my riddle!
Can you guess the answer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
I think I know the answer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You mentioned the other day that you saw a riddle like this on a quiz program. So, the red thing must be...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
No, why'd you have to remember that?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “The animals which call this land home are birds, deer, bears and...?”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think it's telling us to look at the horse that's on display over there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You did say that you're good at geography, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What did geography have to do with that riddle?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's right. The next riddle's on the other side of this horse drawing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nooo! You might actually solve them all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, what did geography have to do with that last one?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, the next one is the final riddle!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Toya and I worked really hard on it!
So, let's see if you can solve it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to get this one right... Wait, we only have three minutes?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... It looks like a crossword puzzle... We just need to solve this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Since you're short on time, here's a little hint! You can solve this crossword puzzle using all the answers that have come up until now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: However, you have to use that solution to find the key to the classroom, so you'll need to hurr—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, there's no way we're gonna be able to solve this crossword puzzle in time!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, do you think the key's hidden around here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know it goes against the spirit of the game, but this is just my guess knowing Mizuki's personality...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's no way the key is hidden somewhere normal or obvious like a treasure chest, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But something tells me it wouldn't be under a desk or behind a curtain or anything like that either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because it'd be hiding in plain sight. Mizuki has a talent for squeezing out the biggest reaction from someone, you know? Just think about our music videos. We're always talking about where it's gonna climax.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Again, this is a complete guess...
But I have a feeling that the key is hidden somewhere amongst these plushies.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aha! There's something rigid in this one...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes!
It has a zipper on its back! I think we can open it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. And I can finally say that I got one of these darn riddles... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, you were so close!
You actually were on the right track!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, so...!
What was the answer?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You were right about the plushies, but you didn't look up! Up!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
There's a plushie hanging from the ceiling. I didn't notice because it was so dark...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you'd actually solved the crossword puzzle, then you would've learned the final keyword. Which was “ceiling”. The idea was to get you to look up and find the key inside it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But all you did was take a stab in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Thanks for playing!
Head back to reception to receive a lovely consolation prize♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My original plan was to hide the key in one of the plushies sitting on that desk.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But Toya said right at the end that we should add an extra layer of intrigue.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(They all know me really well.
They get me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They remember all the things I say during our conversations and understand my thought process when it comes to our videos.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't help but smile whenever we're all together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In other words, whenever I'm with them, I feel...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want us to keep hanging out, but I also want them to know...)

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Thank you all for visiting Kamiyama High School. We regret to inform you that today's festival will now be coming to a close.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew... I finally got to change out of that thing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a shame since that shirt looked so good on you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again, that doesn't make me happy at all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm glad nothing happened and we got to see everything together.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, we should probably excuse ourselves here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you for inviting us.
I had a lot of fun today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can we talk in person again soon?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you two...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great.
Then, I'll let you know what's up later!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Then, see you two later!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's almost time for the night festival...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Most people are gonna start heading for the courtyard, so we should probably talk up there...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Actually, that's exactly where I want to talk...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The place where I became connected to everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The place where Ena said she'd wait. Up there.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wanna go up to the rooftop...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wanna tell you properly... What I couldn't that time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This place is so empty now that the night festival is starting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The building feels like a ghost town since everyone's heading towards the courtyard right now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not interested in the night festival, but I do kinda like how quiet it is here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There were so many people a second ago, but now it's really calm... I feel like I could turn that into a good drawing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I bet you'd capture this situation in a really interesting way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We could even use this idea for one of our videos if the right song comes up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We haven't done anything like that before, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The festival's over and the school's empty, but something new is about to start...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, the song would begin... And stuff would happen from there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Stuff would happen”? I think your idea's gonna need more work...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Cut me some slack, will you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We can just hammer out the details together like always.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She doesn't want me to feel nervous or uncomfortable, so she's making a point of talking to me the way she usually does...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, when we do make that video, I might have you draw that T-shirt you wore today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? I never wanna think about that smelly and lame piece of junk ever again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but I really doubt you're gonna just toss it. I'm guessing that you're gonna keep it somewhere safe.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's going in the trash the second I get home!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, what's up? Is something wrong? You look like you're out of breath...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Yeah, so...!
Someone got hurt when one of the dividers came crashing down all of a sudden...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
And there was no one in the nurse's office...!
Can you help us find the nurse, Akiyama...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sorry, Ena.
Can you head up to the rooftop? I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Actually, do you want me to help?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, this is our class's problem...
And you don't know what any of the daytime teachers look like, right? I'll be fine on my own.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, I'll be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Sorry, Akiyama! I really appreciate it...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's so like Mizuki to help like this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, I remember seeing a nice sunset when we talked that other time too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have no idea what I'm going to hear in a minute...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm glad this is finally happening...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to make sure that I'm able to accept whatever it is.)
Cool, there's no one else up here...!

Lucky us!
The night festival sounds pretty lame, so let's chill up here.

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Same here. I heard there's an after-party later, but I dunno if I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Male Student C
rows.Line: Yeah, me neither. I'm kinda tired.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If there are people here, maybe we should find somewhere—)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: By the way, was that Akiyama running in the corridor just now?

rows.Speaker: Male Student C
rows.Line: Akiyama'd be pretty cute if it weren't for...y'know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, Mizuki is good-looking, you'd have to admit.)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Oh! Weren't you going around with Akiyama today?

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Cool it man, what are you doing getting in her face like that? You're weirding her out.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
C'mon, where's your festival spirit?
I haven't seen you much around here. Are you a pal of Akiyama's?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well... We've known each other for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Does that mean you're also a dude?

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: C'mon, it was just a joke. Hahaha, sorry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A joke...? It wasn't funny at all.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Hey, I said I was sorry. I'm sure you're actually a regular girl—

rows.Speaker: Male Student C
rows.Line: H-Hey, I think she seriously doesn't know...

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: I told you to cut it out!

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: B-But, she said they've known each other for a while. Why wouldn't she know?!

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: It's not like Akiyama hides it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I take the passageway, maybe I can cut ahead...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Even if I do... What do I say...?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I should have told you sooner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just now, you... You were just surprised...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's the only thing you felt...
I know...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All of it, I get it, really...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So tomorrow, you'll say hi as if nothing's changed...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You'll all just say “Oh, really?”...!
And we'll just get to work like normal...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the next day, and every day after that, everything will stay the same...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's...what you're gonna let me think...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'll come from a warm...good place...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thought of you all feeling like you have to be kind like that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just... I can't bear it...!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sorry I never said anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sorry I couldn't face up to this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I ran away, and I kept on running...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And all the while, I hoped someone would eventually say it for me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Be careful what you wish for, huh.)
